_note: PROVISIONAL gameplay vocabulary. The handoff asks proposals to use 'the supplied gameplay vocabulary', but none is in this repository, so these terms are a stand-in so that records can be compared. Every rating is relative (1 weakest, 5 strongest, 3 = an ordinary European line unit of 1805), not an engine number. When the integration team supplies the real vocabulary, map these terms to it and delete this file.

unit_ratings.fire: Effect of musketry or gunnery at its normal range.
unit_ratings.shock: Effect in close assault or a charge.
unit_ratings.mobility: Ground covered in a turn, by unit family.
unit_ratings.range: Reach in hexes relative to a line musket (3 = musket, 4 = rifle or light gun, 5 = heavy gun).
unit_ratings.morale: Willingness to keep fighting after loss.

nation_ratings.industry: Capacity to produce guns, ships and equipment, relative.
nation_ratings.technology: Access to the scenario's most modern equipment, relative.
nation_ratings.stability: Resistance to revolt and break-away events, relative.
